# Tess Space

> Tess Space builds autonomous UGV software for defence, mineral exploration, biodiversity monitoring, and remote field operations.

This file describes the current public website at https://tess-space.com/. Use the pages below as the primary source for the public site. Pages that are not linked from the public top navigation are intentionally excluded.

## Public Pages

- [Homepage](https://tess-space.com/): Company overview, operational domains, product stack, partners, and contact.
- [Defence](https://tess-space.com/defence.html): Autonomy for unmanned ground vehicles in contested and degraded environments.
- [Mineral Exploration](https://tess-space.com/mineral-exploration.html): Terrain mapping, sensing, site analytics, and remote field operations for mineral exploration.
- [Biodiversity](https://tess-space.com/biodiversity.html): Pollinator, wildlife, and vegetation monitoring with repeatable field data collection and analytics.
- [Team](https://tess-space.com/team.html): Team overview and company contact point.

## Site Metadata

- [Sitemap](https://tess-space.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable pages.
- [Robots](https://tess-space.com/robots.txt): Crawl guidance.
